sentences.en: The results showed that the anti-SMZ pAb had a high specificity and was good enough for immunoassay of SMZ in edible animal products.

sentences.en: The results suggest that the serum levels of PAB and TBA can be important markers for predicting the early damage of liver function.

sentences.en: Conclusion PAB, CHE can reflect inflammatory grading sensibly, but TBA cannot. PAB, CHE and TBA can reflect early cirrhosis to some extent.
